id.description: Stable entry id. Local. Not a secret.

started_at.description: Local ISO time. Written during or immediately after.

mind.description: Mood at start, quality of attention.

sky.description: Weather, moon phase, moon sign if a brief supplied it.

held.description: What was impressed or attended, if anything.

did.description: What was actually done. Clock it if it ran long.

happened.description: Impressions. Separate from any forecast wording.

matched.description: Optional. Only against a prior card.

not_concluded.description: Required. A match is not a law.

result_later.description: Empty until a later entry fills it.

prior_id.description: Points at an earlier entry when this row is the after-action review.
